no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division decided not to take this NDA to the Psychopharmacological Drugs Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for TRINTELLIX (vortioxetine, NDA204447). The Medical Review states in its Advisory Committee Meeting section that the Division decided not to take this NDA to the Psychopharmacological Drugs Advisory Committee. The only committee referenced in the review documents is the internal Pediatric Review Committee (PeCR) concerning the PREA pediatric study plan, which is not an external advisory committee, so there are no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
